speaker: Prof Lim Sun Sun
text: asked the Prime Minister whether the Singapore Bicentennial celebration will make a greater effort to reflect the contributions that women have made to Singapore's nation-building.

speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Prime Minister)
text: This includes women and men of different ethnicities.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), provided that Members had not asked for questions standing in their names to be postponed to a later Sitting day or withdrawn, written answers to questions not reached by the end of Question Time are reproduced in the Appendix.]
